correctness.rationale: The cubical model has 153, 432, 297 cells, with exact signed boundaries whose composition vanishes. The C1 boundary has rank 152. Exact rank 270 of C2->C1 follows from a rank-270 modulo-3 minor lower bound and ten independent lifted graph fundamental cycles proving an upper bound; thus Betti 1,10,27 over Q. The natural H1 map is equivariant and an isomorphism. All 216 automorphisms, all 13 conjugacy classes, and all signed cellular actions are verified; the Lefschetz identity yields exact H2 traces and subgroup averages. The packaged verifier was actually run and reproduced the recorded output; no finite experiment is used to assert a family theorem.

value.rationale: The 18-vertex Pappus Levi graph is a classical 216-symmetric configuration graph. The complete 13-class top-homology character is a natural, exact invariant of its two-particle collision-free topology. The nontrivial separation between order-three subgroup invariants (9) and full/index-two quotient invariants (0), and between distinct involution and order-four traces (±3), cannot be inferred from ordinary Betti numbers or generic torsion/rank formulas. The scope is a complete canonical finite classification, not an arbitrary slice or a tiny numerical improvement.
